world.title: 掠过黑洞时看见的扭曲星空
world.posterHook: 从遥远星海靠近，看光被拉成灿烂圆环；越过最近点，再回头看它缩成一粒金色星光。
world.posterSource: Eric Bruneton Black Hole Shader · BSD-3-Clause · Gaia DR2 / Tycho 2
world.question: 如果从深空掠过黑洞，你会看见怎样的宇宙？
world.hook: 从深空启程，亲手推进一次靠近、近掠与远离。你可以藏起飞行器，只留下被黑洞弯曲成光环的星海。
world.payoff: 停在黑洞旁并不等于失重，飞船必须持续加速；熄火后才进入自由落体。速度足够时，轨迹会在最近点转弯并重新逃向深空。

en.title: The distorted sky seen on a black-hole flyby
en.posterTitle: The sky on a flyby past a black hole
en.posterHook: Approach through a sea of stars, hover by a blazing ring, then fly past and watch the black hole recede to a golden point.
en.posterSource: Eric Bruneton Black Hole Shader · BSD-3-Clause · Gaia DR2 / Tycho 2
en.question: What would the universe look like on a flyby past a black hole?
en.hook: Set out from deep space and guide a complete approach, close pass, and departure. Hide the spacecraft to leave only a sea of stars bent into rings by the black hole.
en.payoff: Hovering near a black hole is not weightlessness: the ship must keep accelerating. In fast enough free fall, the geodesic bends around closest approach and escapes back into deep space.
